answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 36552 Country: India Title: I have few doubts if you take wudhu and sleep then wudhu breaks but if we make it during night before sleeping whether it breaks or not Question: (1) I have few doubts if you take wudhu and sleep then wudhu breaks but if we make it during night before sleeping whether it breaks or not? (2) What is the punishment for homosexuality in Islam and for over masturbation? Answer ID: 36552 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 215/121/H=1433) (1) If you sleep laying then wudhu shall break. What is your doubt regarding it? Sleeping is one of the things which nullify the wudhu. (2) Both the acts are haram and major sins. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
